question: Should ai& become a supported built-in CodexBar provider once successful funded-account behavior is demonstrated?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible, but accepting another permanent provider and support obligation is a repository product-scope decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Sponsor after live proof
options.body: Accept the built-in provider after the contributor supplies redacted successful retrieval/rendering evidence and removes the release-owned changelog edit.

options.title: Decline built-in support
options.body: Close the PR without merging if ai& does not meet the repository's provider-adoption or long-term support bar.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the built-in provider after the contributor supplies redacted successful retrieval/rendering evidence and removes the release-owned changelog edit.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner has made prior provider-admission decisions and owns the product boundary for the built-in provider list.
